Two atoms, X and Y, have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.
Which statement about X and Y is correct?
A
They have the same number of protons.
B
They have the same number of electrons.
C
They are in the same group of the Periodic Table.
D
They have different numbers of neutrons.

options.label: A
options.text: They have the same number of protons.

options.label: B
options.text: They have the same number of electrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They are in the same group of the Periodic Table.

options.label: D
options.text: They have different numbers of neutrons.
